name: Catalan nationalism
summary: Catalan nationalism holds that Catalans form a distinct nation, grounded in their language, history and medieval self-government, and that Catalonia is entitled to govern itself. It ranges from the autonomist, conservative Lliga and Pujol tradition to today's mainly pro-independence movement, which demands a binding referendum and a Catalan Republic, with left (ERC, CUP) and centre-right (Junts) wings. Language recovery and defence of Catalan is central, and mainstream nationalism presents itself as civic and inclusive.
scope: The mainstream political Catalanism and nationalism from the Renaixença and the Bases de Manresa (1892) and Prat de la Riba's La nacionalitat catalana (1906) through to the 2010s independence movement (ERC, Junts/CDC, CUP, the 2013 sovereignty declaration and the 2017 referendum). Answers reflect the typical modern adherent who supports self-determination; the far-right fringe (Aliança Catalana) and the early Maurrasian elitist strand are excluded. Many economic and social answers are inferred low-confidence because the movement spans left and right.

keyFigures.name: Lluís Companys

missingStatements.text: A region should collect its own taxes and pass the central government only an agreed share.
missingStatements.rationale: Base 6 of 1892 gave Catalonia taxation and the modern movement presses for fiscal control, though the existing regional-revenue statement partly captures it.

missingStatements.text: A national parliament or court should not be able to overturn a statute that the voters of a region approved in a referendum.
missingStatements.rationale: The 2010 Constitutional Court ruling on the 2006 statute approved by 73% of voters triggered the right-to-decide mobilisation.
missingStatements.declined: Specific to Spain's Constitutional Court dispute; covered loosely by right-to-secede and national-self-determination.

notes: The movement spans conservative Christian-democratic, liberal and left strands, so most economic and social answers are low-confidence inferences. Aliança Catalana is far-right and anti-immigration, outside this profile.

universal-healthcare.rationale: ERC, the main left nationalist party, is social democratic, and Catalan nationalism across parties has not contested public health provision.

raise-minimum-wage.rationale: Inferred from the left-wing nationalist parties (ERC, CUP); the centre-right strand is less committed, so this is an inference only.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: The movement spans free-market centre-right Junts/CiU and left ERC/CUP, so no single answer holds.

public-ownership.rationale: Left parties favour public utilities while the conservative strand of the Lliga and CDC tradition does not; adherents are split.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: Left nationalists want higher taxes on the rich while centre-right nationalists do not, so the movement is divided.

unions-good.rationale: Inferred from the left-wing nationalist parties' ties to labour; the movement has no unified labour doctrine.

property-fundamental.rationale: The bourgeois Lliga tradition stressed property while ERC and CUP are left-wing; adherents split.

regulate-corporations.rationale: Inferred from the centre-left to left position of ERC; the centre-right strand is lukewarm.

cut-welfare.rationale: No major nationalist party campaigns on cutting welfare; ERC is social democratic and this is inferred for the movement as a whole.

worker-ownership.rationale: The classic nationalist programme was interclass; only the CUP end of the movement would back collective worker ownership.

surveillance-ok.rationale: Inferred from the movement's experience of state policing and courts in 2017 and its liberal-democratic outlook.

legalize-drugs.rationale: Inferred from ERC's progressive social stance; the movement has no doctrine on drugs.

restrict-hate-speech.rationale: ERC is anti-racist and favours restrictions, but nationalists also resist prosecution of speech; no settled line.

strong-leader.rationale: Nationalists present their cause as a democratic mass movement, and Catalan tradition (pactisme) favours contractual limits on rulers.

state-harmful.rationale: The movement seeks a state of its own, a Catalan Republic, so it plainly regards the state as necessary.

limit-guns.rationale: Inferred from the progressive centre-left majority of the movement; no source discusses it.

empower-police-military.rationale: Nationalists value the Catalan police (Mossos) but distrust Spanish forces after 2017, so there is no clear answer.

legalize-sex-work.rationale: Left nationalist parties are divided on sex work like others on the left; no movement line.

decide-locally.rationale: The Bases de Manresa demanded regional control of legislation, taxes and administration, favouring decisions near the people.

rehabilitation.rationale: Inferred from ERC's left-liberal outlook; the sources say nothing on prisons.

traditional-family.rationale: Conservative nationalists and progressive ones differ; the movement takes no joint line.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: ERC is described as pro-LGBTQ rights, and the movement as a whole is socially liberal.

abortion-legal.rationale: Inferred from ERC's feminist and progressive positions; Christian-democratic UDC differed.

more-religion-public.rationale: ERC is secular and left-wing and the movement is not clerical, though the Catholic Church played a role in its history.

correct-racial-injustice.rationale: ERC is anti-racist, but the issue is not a core nationalist concern and the movement is split.

gender-social-construct.rationale: Left nationalist parties are feminist and likely to agree, conservatives would not; no unified view.

preserve-national-culture.rationale: The Renaixença and the defence of the Catalan language and traditions are the foundation of Catalan nationalism.

gradual-change.rationale: The movement combined gradual autonomy-seeking (Lliga, Pujol) with mass mobilisation for rupture (2017), so adherents split.

reduce-immigration.rationale: Mainstream nationalism and ERC are pro-immigration, though a small far-right strand (Aliança Catalana) disagrees.

empower-international-orgs.rationale: Nationalists look to Europe and international recognition for their cause; ERC is pro-European.

free-trade.rationale: Catalan industrialists historically backed Spanish protectionism, while modern parties are pro-EU; no common line.

nation-first.rationale: ERC and mainstream nationalists are internationalist and pro-European, though the nation's interests are central.

humanitarian-intervention.rationale: Not an issue in the sources; ERC is anti-colonial but no position on intervention is documented.

open-borders.rationale: ERC is pro-immigration but the movement does not call for open borders; no stated line.

limit-growth.rationale: ERC is described as environmentalist but not degrowth; inferred disagreement.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: ERC is environmentalist and in the Greens-EFA group; inferred for the movement.

tech-solves-problems.rationale: Nothing in the sources; Catalan nationalism has no stance on technology.

expand-nuclear.rationale: Inferred from ERC and CUP environmentalism; the movement has no documented stance on nuclear power.

revolution-justified.rationale: Leaders such as Torra stress that violence is not the movement's flag; democratic means are central.

experts-over-public.rationale: The movement stresses popular will, the right to decide and referendums.

central-planning.rationale: Even ERC is social democratic, not planned-economy; inferred.

socialized-markets.rationale: Only the CUP end is socialist; the movement overall has no line.

land-value-tax.rationale: No nationalist party advocates a land tax; inferred disagreement.

tax-inheritance.rationale: Left nationalists would agree, the centre-right would not; split.

basic-income.rationale: ERC and CUP have sympathy for such ideas but there is no movement-wide position.

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: The Lliga's industrial base wanted Spanish tariffs, but a modern independent Catalonia is pro-EU; no common view.

state-directs-investment.rationale: The Lliga era favoured promoting Catalan industry; modern parties are divided.

abolish-money-wages.rationale: Inferred; even the CUP is not stated to seek moneyless society in the sources.

abolish-central-banks.rationale: The movement is pro-EU and expects to join the euro system; inferred.

corporatist-bargaining.rationale: The Bases of 1892 envisaged corporative organisation of representation, but modern nationalism does not hold to it.

one-party-rule.rationale: The movement is a coalition of competing parties committed to elections and referendums.

monarchy-legitimate.rationale: Independence supporters seek a Catalan Republic; the 2017 question asked about a republic and Puigdemont omitted the oath to the king.

democracy-best.rationale: The movement bases its claim on democratic legitimacy, the 2013 sovereignty declaration invoking it explicitly.

direct-votes.rationale: The right to decide and the 2014 and 2017 referendums make direct votes on major questions central.

workers-councils.rationale: Even the left nationalists are parliamentary republicans; inferred.

right-to-secede.rationale: The 2013 declaration called the Catalan people a sovereign political subject, and the movement demands a referendum on independence.

natural-rulers.rationale: Contradicts the democratic, popular-sovereignty basis of the movement.

political-violence-never.rationale: Leaders such as Torra said violence was never the movement's flag and condemned the 2019 riots.

war-builds-character.rationale: Inferred from the peaceful, civic character of the movement.

separate-church-state.rationale: ERC is secular and left; inferred, though Catholic Catalanism existed.

laws-from-scripture.rationale: No nationalist party advocates religious law.

private-courts-defense.rationale: The movement seeks a state with its own courts and defence; inferred.

military-superiority.rationale: Nationalists hardly stress military power; the Bases offered a volunteer or cash contribution to the army.

ethnic-nation.rationale: Prat de la Riba's nation was cultural and the Renanian civic concept influenced the left; modern parties say whoever lives in Catalonia is Catalan.

class-struggle-history.rationale: The Lliga's nationalism was interclass; only the radical left would give class conflict this role.

equal-outcomes.rationale: Left and right in the movement differ.

indigenous-land-authority.rationale: Nothing in sources; ERC is anti-colonial but no position is documented.

colonial-reparations.rationale: ERC is anti-colonial but the sources document no stance on reparations.

civilizational-union.rationale: Catalan nationalists seek a nation-state in Europe, not union by civilisation.

self-interest-moral.rationale: No documented position; bourgeois and left strands differ.

duties-before-rights.rationale: The movement is liberal-democratic and frames its demand as a right to decide.

industrial-civilization-disaster.rationale: The Lliga era embraced industrialisation as Catalonia's strength.

accelerate-technology.rationale: Catalan nationalism has no stance on the pace of technological change; the sources are silent, so neutral.

human-enhancement.rationale: Nothing in the nationalist programme touches body enhancement, so no position can be drawn.

algorithmic-government.rationale: Inferred; the movement emphasises citizen voting and participation.

unbreakable-encryption.rationale: Not addressed in sources; movement activists were concerned with surveillance, but no line is documented.

restore-past-order.rationale: The Renaixença revived history and language but looked to self-government, not restoring a lost order over progress.

results-over-ideology.rationale: The sources document no view; the movement mixes pragmatic autonomism with principled sovereignty.

direct-action.rationale: Mass peaceful mobilisation supplemented parliamentary routes, which parties used, so direct action alone is not preferred.

means-match-ends.rationale: Peaceful means for a democratic republic fit, but the sources state no principle.

abolish-division-of-labor.rationale: Not part of any nationalist tradition.

distribute-by-need.rationale: Only the radical left end holds this; ERC is social democratic.

production-for-use.rationale: Same; the movement is not anti-profit.

profit-exploitation.rationale: Left parties like CUP might agree but the movement as a whole does not.

dictatorship-of-proletariat.rationale: Nationalism is a democratic, multi-party movement.

collective-farming.rationale: Not part of any nationalist programme; ERC historically protected tenant farmers on individual holdings.

capitalism-causes-war.rationale: Only the radical left holds this.

taxation-theft.rationale: The movement aims to build a state with its own taxation; Base 6 of 1892 gave Catalonia tax collection.

harm-principle.rationale: Inferred from the movement's liberal democratic outlook.

individual-rights-only.rationale: The movement claims collective rights for the Catalan people, such as self-determination.

conscription.rationale: The Bases supplied the army by volunteers or cash payment, implying aversion to conscription.

exit-over-voice.rationale: The movement values the vote (referendums) and does not prefer exit.

state-as-business.rationale: Not documented; the movement seeks a public-service state.

hereditarian-race.rationale: ERC is anti-racist and the movement defines nationhood by culture.

organic-representation.rationale: The 1892 Bases wanted corporative suffrage by heads of families and classes, but the modern movement uses parties.

total-state.rationale: The movement is liberal-democratic, making state direction of all life alien.

national-rebirth.rationale: The Renaixença was a literal rebirth of culture, but the statement's radical decadence framing is not documented as such.

territorial-expansion.rationale: The aim is self-government for Catalonia, not expansion, apart from the Catalan Countries claim of cultural unity.

personal-loyalty-rule.rationale: Contrary to the democratic basis of the movement.

bound-labor.rationale: Feudal bound labour has no place in any nationalist programme; inferred from the movement's democratic character.

no-neutral-knowledge.rationale: No source ties Catalan nationalism to an epistemological stance, so it is neutral.

single-common-good.rationale: The Lliga era combined classes in an interclass nation, but no doctrine of a single common good is in the sources.

jewish-state-israel.rationale: Catalan nationalism has no unified view; some draw parallels with self-determination, others differ.

diaspora-return-right.rationale: The sources discuss no diaspora return policy, so neutral.

revive-national-language.rationale: The recovery of Catalan was central to the Renaixença and to nationalism, though it was never wholly out of use.

workplace-democracy.rationale: Left nationalists favour it, others do not.

school-vouchers.rationale: Nationalists defend public schooling through Catalan immersion, so vouchers are unlikely to be favoured.

avoid-deficit-stimulus.rationale: Split between left and right nationalists.

rule-by-example.rationale: Movement relies on laws and institutions of self-government.

national-self-determination.rationale: The 2013 declaration and the 2017 referendum demand that the Catalan nation decide its political future.

force-without-un.rationale: Catalan nationalists look to international legitimacy; inferred.

reason-over-faith.rationale: Catholic Catalanism and secular republicanism coexist in the movement, so it has no common view.

welfare-for-citizens.rationale: ERC is pro-immigration and anti-racist, though the 'Aliança' far right differs.

class-collaboration.rationale: The Lliga's nationalism was an interclass project uniting industrialists and workers within the nation.

sacrifice-heritage.rationale: The Renaixença is itself the recovery of inherited cultural institutions.

dominated-front.rationale: ERC is anti-colonial but the movement orients to the EU, not a bloc against the West.

workers-nation.rationale: The left nationalist parties merge class and national projects, but no unified line.

distinct-gender-roles.rationale: ERC is feminist; the movement is not an advocate of this.

ban-interest.rationale: Nothing in any nationalist programme concerns interest, and Catalan finance is conventional, so this is rejected by inference.

racial-segregation-law.rationale: ERC is anti-racist and the movement's civic nationalism rejects it.

state-class-instrument.rationale: Only the radical left holds this view.

assimilate-immigrants.rationale: The movement expects integration into Catalan language and civic life but its civic nationalism does not demand giving up other cultures.

elite-replacement.rationale: ERC is pro-immigration, and the movement does not hold such conspiracy views.

proportional-representation.rationale: Small nationalist parties benefit from proportional rules; inferred.

national-mission.rationale: The nation is defined by self-government, not a mission to others.

patriarchy-structural.rationale: ERC is feminist but the movement is not united.

political-elite-corrupt.rationale: The movement is itself part of the political class; the Pujol scandals divided opinion.

heritable-defect-limits.rationale: Rejected by inference from the movement's liberal outlook and ERC's anti-racist stance.

security-forces-accountable.rationale: Franco's regime executed Companys; the movement values memory and accountability.

night-watchman-state.rationale: The movement seeks a full state; ERC is social democratic.

discourage-race-mixing.rationale: Rejected by inference from ERC's anti-racist stance and the movement's civic definition of the nation.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: ERC and the movement's civic nationalism claim equality before the law for all residents.

socialism-one-country.rationale: A Marxist doctrinal question that nationalist sources never address, so neutral.

uniform-civil-code.rationale: The Lliga won a Catalan Civil Code, which supports uniform civil law within a territory; the religious aspect is not discussed.

restrict-conversion.rationale: Contrary to the movement's liberal outlook.

no-religion-state-schools.rationale: ERC is secular and left; inferred.

state-strengthens-encirclement.rationale: Not addressed; inferred from democratic orientation.

consent-of-governed.rationale: The 2013 sovereignty declaration grounded the Catalan people's status in democratic legitimacy and the movement's referendum demand rests on consent.

initiating-force-wrong.rationale: The movement stresses non-violence but has no libertarian doctrine.

competition-drives-progress.rationale: Not part of the nationalist outlook.

ban-extremist-parties.rationale: The movement itself was targeted by court rulings and by Article 155.

freedom-as-non-domination.rationale: Nationalists see Spain's rule as external domination but no republican theory is stated.

separated-powers.rationale: The movement criticises the Spanish courts' role, and endorses the parliamentary republic.

vanguard-party.rationale: The movement is multi-party and democratic.

priority-to-poor.rationale: ERC is social democratic; centre-right less so.

right-to-buy-council-homes.rationale: Housing tenure is not addressed in any nationalist source, so neutral.

diversity-weakens-cohesion.rationale: ERC is pro-immigration, and mainstream Catalan nationalism calls itself inclusive.

emergency-suspend-protections.rationale: The movement opposed Article 155 and the direct rule imposed in 2017.

price-controls-essentials.rationale: Price policy is not part of the nationalist programme; the left and right strands differ.

party-commands-army.rationale: Rejected by inference from the movement's multi-party parliamentary republicanism.

party-discipline-binding.rationale: Party organisation rules are not addressed in the nationalist sources, so neutral.

pool-sovereignty.rationale: ERC is pro-European and mainstream nationalism wants an independent Catalonia within the EU, though the CUP is eurosceptic.

head-commands-forces.rationale: The movement favours a parliamentary republic.

church-by-bishops.rationale: Church governance is not a nationalist issue; the sources say nothing, so neutral.

censor-art-for-virtue.rationale: Rejected by inference: the Renaixença was a cultural movement that prized free literary expression.

recall-officials.rationale: Inferred from emphasis on popular voting.

abolish-rental-housing.rationale: No nationalist programme proposes banning rented housing, so rejected by inference.

people-in-arms.rationale: The Bases envisaged a standing army contribution; no armed-citizen programme.

rural-life-healthier.rationale: Early Catalanism had rural traditionalism but the Lliga was industrial; no unified view.

reunify-divided-nation.rationale: ERC's stated aim includes the territorial unity of the Catalan Countries, though CiU did not prioritise it.

educated-out-of-touch.rationale: The movement was led by intellectuals and has strong academic ties.

cultures-equal-different.rationale: Defence of a small culture's equal standing is a typical nationalist argument; inferred.

death-penalty.rationale: Liberal and left outlook; Companys was himself executed.

creationism-in-schools.rationale: No nationalist source supports this, and ERC is secular and progressive, so rejected by inference.

restrict-pornography.rationale: Not a nationalist issue; the liberal and left majority is inferred to lean against restriction.

citizenship-by-descent.rationale: The Bases tie office to Catalan birth or naturalisation, and modern civic nationalism accepts residents as Catalans.

minority-language-support.rationale: Defending Catalan in schools and public life is central for ERC and the movement; the Catalan government defends immersion with Catalan as the centre of gravity of schooling.

religious-exemptions.rationale: The sources do not discuss exemptions from general laws for religious minorities, so neutral.

encourage-eccentricity.rationale: Not addressed in the nationalist sources, which are concerned with collective identity, so neutral.

sovereign-debt-cancellation.rationale: Foreign debt of poor countries is not addressed by sources, so neutral.

independence-needs-economic-change.rationale: ERC and CUP link them, Junts does not; split.

constituent-assembly.rationale: The independence movement proposes a constituent process for a Catalan Republic; inferred from its platform.

restrict-freedoms-for-growth.rationale: Contrary to the democratic basis of the movement.

rich-countries-aid-poor.rationale: Inferred from ERC's anti-colonial, left outlook.

direct-election-head-of-state.rationale: A republic is wanted but the head's selection method is not settled in sources.

central-bank-independence.rationale: Monetary policy is not treated in the sources; neutral.

no-land-for-peace.rationale: The sources address no peace-for-land question, so neutral.

property-serves-common-good.rationale: Property theory is not addressed in the sources; the strands differ, so neutral.

soviet-state-capitalist.rationale: A debate in Marxist theory that nationalist sources do not touch, so neutral.

collective-defense.rationale: Inferred from pro-European, Atlanticist-friendly mainstream; weak evidence.

annexed-territory-occupation.rationale: The movement sees Spain's centralisation after 1714 as imposed, supporting the principle; modern text on law is not documented.

subordinate-church-to-state.rationale: ERC is secular but the sources do not mention curbing church property.

nonpartisan-head-of-state.rationale: Mostly reflects the rejection of monarchy; republicans may want a ceremonial president though.

force-to-prevent-secession.rationale: The movement condemned Spain's judicial and political measures including the invocation of Article 155 against the 2017 declaration.

region-keeps-system.rationale: The Lliga sought self-government inside a reformed Spain and the Mancomunitat, with its own civil code.

character-from-environment.rationale: The Renanian civic strand sees nation as formed by shared life; inferred.

sovereign-above-law.rationale: Pactisme describes a contractual balance of crown and institutions.

space-expansion.rationale: Nothing in the nationalist programme addresses space, so neutral.

mixed-constitution.rationale: Classical mixed-constitution theory is not part of Catalan nationalist sources, so neutral.

equal-parenting.rationale: Family law on custody is not addressed by the sources, so neutral.

class-struggle-under-socialism.rationale: A Marxist-Leninist debate absent from the nationalist sources, so neutral.

land-redistribution.rationale: ERC's 1930s Crop Contracts Law protected tenants, not redistribution.

refugee-return.rationale: Inferred from ERC's anti-colonial, rights-oriented outlook.

co-ethnic-territorial-claim.rationale: The Catalan Countries are claimed as cultural unity, and ERC works through consent, so no claim to others' territory is pressed.

apostasy-punishable.rationale: Rejected by inference from the secular, liberal character of the movement and ERC.

women-must-cover.rationale: Opposed by feminist and secular parties.

kin-peoples-union.rationale: The pan-Catalanism of ERC and others aims at unity of Catalan-speaking territories, though CiU gave it less weight.

national-cultural-autonomy.rationale: The movement seeks a state or a sovereign Catalan Republic, not only cultural autonomy.

rights-where-you-live.rationale: Does not apply to the Catalan case.

material-conditions-drive-history.rationale: The movement stresses language and national identity as drivers.

ban-cartels.rationale: Competition policy is not addressed in the sources, so neutral.

no-bailouts.rationale: Bailout policy is not addressed in the sources, so neutral.

courts-bound-by-majority.rationale: Nationalists protested the 2010 Constitutional Court ruling on a statute approved by voters, so favour popular majorities over courts.

economic-self-sufficiency.rationale: Industrialists wanted access to Spanish markets and the movement is pro-EU.

trade-labor-env-standards.rationale: Inferred from ERC's left and green orientation.

armed-group-creates-revolution.rationale: Rejected: leaders stress that the movement is peaceful and democratic, not armed.

abolish-hereditary-privilege.rationale: Republicans reject monarchy; titles not specifically discussed.

history-own-civilization.rationale: The Renaixença used Catalan history as proof of nationhood and teaching it is a nationalist aim.

patriotic-education.rationale: National pride and symbols are central to the movement, though sources document no specific schooling rule.

end-racial-preferences.rationale: Affirmative action is not a Catalan issue and the sources do not discuss it, so neutral.

public-money-creation.rationale: Monetary reform is not part of the nationalist programme, so neutral.

capitalism-adapts.rationale: A Marxist theoretical question not treated by the sources, so neutral.

former-empire-influence.rationale: The sources do not describe any nostalgia for imperial influence; neutral.

labor-aristocracy.rationale: A Leninist theory that nationalist sources do not take up, so neutral.

freedom-to-discriminate.rationale: Rejected by inference from ERC's anti-racist, pro-LGBTQ stance and the movement's civic nationalism.

entrenched-bill-of-rights.rationale: A Catalan Republic constitution would be expected to include one; inferred.

colonial-treaties-void.rationale: The sources do not discuss colonial treaties, so neutral.

elective-rulers.rationale: The movement seeks a republic in place of a hereditary monarch.

minority-veto.rationale: Contrary to the majoritarian referendum approach.

resist-lawless-ruler.rationale: Pactisme treats the crown's rule as a contract with Catalan institutions, implying legitimate resistance to breach of it.

parliament-supreme.rationale: The 2013 declaration claimed sovereignty for the Catalan people and the Parlament acted on it in 2017.

animal-use-humane.rationale: Not addressed in the sources, though Catalonia banned bullfighting; no clear line on farming, so neutral.

noblesse-oblige.rationale: The sources do not discuss duties of the privileged; the Lliga was bourgeois while the left rejects the idea, so neutral.

withdraw-from-politics.rationale: The movement is a mass political mobilisation.

mass-culture-pacifies.rationale: A critical-theory claim not found in the nationalist sources, so neutral.

ruling-class-consent.rationale: A Gramscian claim not found in the nationalist sources, so neutral.

world-economy-extracts-surplus.rationale: Nationalists speak of a fiscal deficit with Spain but no world-system view.

native-born-offices.rationale: The 1892 Bases reserved offices for Catalans by birth or naturalisation but modern civic nationalism does not.

party-own-road.rationale: A debate within communism that the nationalist sources never address, so neutral.

self-reliance-over-aid.rationale: Development theory is not addressed by the sources, so neutral.

return-lost-territory.rationale: The movement has not demanded Northern Catalonia from France through force; it claims cultural recognition.

antifascism-founding-value.rationale: ERC is anti-fascist and Companys was executed by Franco.

totalitarianisms-equivalent.rationale: The movement is anti-fascist (ERC, Companys's execution), but the sources do not address the equivalence claim.

slavery-not-civil-war-cause.rationale: A US historiographical question absent from the sources, so neutral.

preserve-contested-monuments.rationale: ERC favours memory and anti-fascism; inferred.

male-disadvantage-attention.rationale: Not addressed in the sources; ERC is feminist but the movement has no stated line on this.

domestic-violence-symmetry.rationale: Disagreed by inference, since ERC is described as feminist and treats violence against women as a distinct structural problem.

institutions-fit-civilization.rationale: The sources do not address whether Western institutions suit other civilizations, so neutral.

military-guardian-role.rationale: The movement was opposed by the state's armed institutions and courts in 2017, and Franco's army crushed Catalan self-government.

paid-care-work.rationale: Recognition of unpaid labour is not addressed in the nationalist sources, so neutral.

filial-duty.rationale: Family ethics are not addressed in the sources, so neutral.

office-by-exam.rationale: Civil-service recruitment is not addressed in the sources, so neutral.

foreign-takeover-block.rationale: Not addressed; the movement's pro-EU, open-market stance points both ways, so neutral.

no-fault-divorce.rationale: Inferred from ERC progressive social stance.

land-use-tenure.rationale: Not part of any nationalist platform.

single-official-language.rationale: The 1892 Bases made Catalan the sole official language, but modern nationalists accept co-official Spanish in Catalonia.

disparate-impact-discrimination.rationale: US-style anti-discrimination doctrine is not addressed in the sources, so neutral.

arm-foreign-insurgents.rationale: Rejected by inference from the movement's peaceful, democratic methods.

corporate-influence.rationale: Left nationalists agree, others less so.

pronatalist-incentives.rationale: Population and family subsidies are not covered in the sources, so neutral.

residents-only-property.rationale: Not addressed in the sources, so neutral.

job-guarantee.rationale: Employment policy is not part of the nationalist programme, so neutral.

no-duty-to-obey.rationale: Mass civil disobedience happened in 2017 but a general doctrine is not stated.

non-intervention.rationale: The movement seeks external recognition; no firm view.

industrial-unions.rationale: Union structure is not a nationalist issue, so neutral.

minority-conspiracy.rationale: Contradicted by the civic and anti-racist stance.

local-production.rationale: Not addressed in the sources, so neutral.

informal-organisation.rationale: The movement works through parties and mass associations.

national-law-over-international.rationale: The movement appeals to international law and European institutions against Spanish courts.

religious-nation.rationale: Nationhood is cultural and linguistic, not religious.

deference-to-leading-power.rationale: Tribute systems are alien to the movement, which seeks self-government and recognition in Europe.

regional-revenue-retention.rationale: The 2006 statute and the 2010 ruling concerned fiscal responsibility for other regions, and the movement claims a fiscal deficit.

personal-possessions-private.rationale: Not addressed in the nationalist sources, so neutral.

mixed-public-service-providers.rationale: Inferred from the centre-left social-market mainstream of the movement; weak.

capitalism-progressive.rationale: Lliga industrialists saw it so, the left does not.

women-equality-needs-economic-change.rationale: Left nationalists might agree and the centre-right not, so there is no movement line.

socialized-care.rationale: Public provision of housework is not addressed in the sources, so neutral.

purge-loanwords.rationale: Language revival focused on standardisation, not purging.

treaties-binding.rationale: Treaty law between governments and nations is not discussed in the sources, so neutral.

cooperative-communities.rationale: Rejected by inference: the movement seeks a conventional state, not communes.

historical-land-claim.rationale: Historical claims feature in the movement's case but sources do not show a view on claims versus residents.

criminalize-homosexuality.rationale: Rejected by inference from ERC's pro-LGBTQ stance and the movement's liberal outlook.

punish-blasphemy.rationale: Rejected by inference from the secular and liberal character of the movement.

participatory-democracy.rationale: Mass mobilisation and citizen consultations such as 2014 show affinity.

left-right-obsolete.rationale: The movement claims to span left, centre and right, but does not call the division obsolete.

alienated-labor.rationale: A Marxist concept not found in the nationalist sources, so neutral.

islam-incompatible.rationale: ERC is pro-immigration and anti-racist; fringe far right disagrees.

divine-source-of-authority.rationale: The movement's claim rests on popular sovereignty.

religious-dress-in-state.rationale: Not addressed in the sources; secular and liberal strands may differ, so neutral.

social-market-economy.rationale: ERC and CiU's tradition both fit.

abolish-armed-forces.rationale: Not addressed in the sources; the Bases kept an army contribution, so neutral.

rich-first.rationale: Development sequencing is not in the sources, so neutral.

stay-neutral-between-blocs.rationale: Foreign-policy alignment is not addressed in the sources, so neutral.

dynastic-succession.rationale: Republican movement rejects hereditary head of state.

refuse-lender-austerity.rationale: Not addressed in the sources, so neutral.

property-franchise.rationale: Movement is democratic; the 1892 Bases limited suffrage to heads of families but this is outdated.

domination-women-nature.rationale: An ecofeminist claim not found in the nationalist sources, so neutral.

reification.rationale: A Marxist concept absent from the nationalist sources, so neutral.

press-owned-by-wealth.rationale: Not addressed in the sources, so neutral.

racial-franchise.rationale: Rejected by inference from the civic definition of Catalan nationhood and ERC's anti-racism.

online-participation.rationale: Inferred from emphasis on popular consultation.

open-government-data.rationale: Inferred approval from the movement's democratic and participatory orientation.

interfaith-marriage-restriction.rationale: Rejected by inference from the liberal, secular character of the movement.

boycott-minority-shops.rationale: Rejected by inference from the inclusive civic character of mainstream nationalism.

reinterpret-religion.rationale: Not addressed in the sources, so neutral.

open-lgbt-military-service.rationale: Inferred approval from ERC's pro-LGBTQIA+ stance.

abolish-police-prisons.rationale: The movement values its own police and state institutions.

power-sharing-divided-societies.rationale: Inferred; Catalan society is divided over independence, but the movement's view is not documented.

charity-over-state-aid.rationale: Inferred: the left (ERC, CUP) favors public provision, and the centre-right Catalan tradition has accepted a public welfare state, so charity-first is a minority view.

term-limits.rationale: Inferred: the sources show no common line, and the movement's parties span left and right.

vote-delegation.rationale: Inferred: parts of the independence movement favor participatory tools (CUP, grassroots assemblies) while established parties stick to representative politics, so it is split.

existential-risk-priority.rationale: Inferred from a movement centered on self-government and language, which does not treat extinction risk as a top priority.

women-in-religious-leadership.rationale: Inferred from the mostly secular, liberal and left-leaning modern movement, which backs equal treatment.

shared-marital-authority.rationale: Inferred from the modern movement's civic, left and liberal mainstream; the sources do not address it.

foreign-residents-local-vote.rationale: ERC, the main left nationalist party, is pro-immigration and civic in its nationalism, so local voting for resident foreigners is inferred as welcome.

rent-control.rationale: Left nationalist parties (ERC, CUP) back social-democratic housing regulation; the movement as a whole has no fixed housing line, so this is inferred.

abolish-ip.rationale: Nothing in the movement targets intellectual property; mainstream Catalan nationalism is market-friendly, so abolition is inferred as rejected.

uniformed-youth.rationale: The independence movement stresses peaceful civic mobilisation, so drilled uniformed youth movements are inferred as foreign to it.

no-nuclear-weapons-on-territory.rationale: The left-leaning, pro-EU nationalist mainstream is inferred to oppose nuclear weapons; the movement has not addressed the question.

no-foreign-bases.rationale: Nationalists are split: the left (CUP, parts of ERC) opposes foreign bases and NATO, while the centre-right is untroubled by them.

recognise-genocide.rationale: A movement built on historical memory and recognition of a people is inferred to favour formal recognition of past mass killings; no source states a position.

income-for-work-not-ownership.rationale: ERC's social-democratic platform favours rewarding work, though the centre-right Junts wing would not stress it; inferred.

never-kill-self-defence.rationale: Catalan nationalism is not pacifist in principle; its peaceful stance is tactical, so an absolute ban on self-defence killing is inferred as rejected.

unbroken-national-continuity.rationale: Prat de la Riba and the Bases de Manresa grounded the Catalan nation in its language, history and medieval self-government, a continuous national tradition.

sex-socially-constructed.rationale: Adherents are split along left-right lines on gender theory; the movement has no stated view, so this is left neutral.

no-fixed-category-of-women.rationale: Gender theory is not a nationalist question and adherents are split, so no position is inferred.

martyrs-honoured.rationale: Mainstream Catalan nationalism is civic and secular-leaning, with commemoration of historical victims but not a cult of martyrs and saints; inferred.

politics-spiritual-struggle.rationale: The independence movement frames politics as a democratic and legal dispute over self-determination, not a spiritual struggle; inferred.

homeland-cultural-centre.rationale: Pan-Catalanism links Catalonia with Valencian and Balearic Catalan speakers, but a diaspora-centre model is not stated, so the movement is treated as split.

culture-before-state.rationale: The Renaixença began as cultural revival, but the modern mainstream movement prioritises self-government and independence; inferred.

god-not-male.rationale: Theological language is not addressed by the movement and adherents are split; no position is inferred.

scripture-judged-by-women.rationale: Religious interpretation is outside the movement's concerns and adherents are split; no position is inferred.

economy-in-majority-hands.rationale: Mainstream Catalan nationalism presents itself as civic and inclusive and the left wing is explicitly pro-immigration, so reserving the economy for the majority is rejected.

single-unit-for-people.rationale: Pan-Catalanism and ERC's Catalan Countries programme seek cultural and sometimes political union of the Catalan-speaking territories.

independent-unions.rationale: Inferred: ERC and the CUP side with union independence, though the Catalan movement is split and the sources do not address the question.

socialism-needs-workers-power.rationale: ERC's left platform holds that real socialism needs popular power, but the movement is mainly nationalist and spans the right; inferred.

local-essentials-public.rationale: Inferred from ERC's social-democratic platform; Junts and the centre-right take a more mixed view.

second-chamber.rationale: Inferred: Catalonia has historically looked to a Senate that represents territories and the Bases de Manresa described a representative system; the sources do not discuss it directly.

municipal-property.rationale: Inferred: the CUP is the outlier favouring community ownership, whereas the mainstream, including ERC and Junts, favours a mixed economy.

confederal-coordination.rationale: Inferred: the Catalan Countries programme and municipalist traditions point to cooperation of territories, though the sources do not state this model.

family-wage.rationale: Inferred from ERC's social democratic platform; the sources do not address family wages.

faster-drug-approval.rationale: Inferred: the movement is pro-EU and pro-science, but the sources do not address drug approval.

ageing-research-funding.rationale: Inferred: Catalan governments back biomedical research, but the sources do not address anti-ageing research.

anonymous-payments.rationale: Inferred: the movement defends civil liberties against Madrid, but the sources say nothing on untraceable payments.

online-anonymity.rationale: Inferred: the independence movement defends civil liberties and was subject to surveillance and prosecution; the sources do not address online anonymity.

person-over-state.rationale: Inferred: mainstream Catalan nationalism presents itself as civic and liberal, so it holds that the state serves the person; not stated.

spiritual-nature.rationale: Inferred: the movement spans secular left and Catholic-rooted centre-right; the sources do not address this.

regional-powers-revocable.rationale: Catalan nationalism demands self-government entrenched in the statute and a binding referendum, and the 2010 ruling cutting the 2006 statute set off the independence movement.

gm-crops.rationale: Inferred: no source addresses GM crops, and the Catalan left and the agrarian sector differ.

dense-cities.rationale: Inferred from ERC's pro-EU, centre-left platform and Barcelona's dense urban model; the sources do not address this.

racial-group-interests.rationale: Mainstream Catalan nationalism presents itself as civic and inclusive, and ERC is pro-immigration, rejecting politics organised by race.

racial-pride.rationale: Inferred: the movement defines the nation by language and history, not race; it does not address racial pride, so a mild disagree.

defensive-wars-only.rationale: Inferred: the independence movement's emphasis on peaceful mobilisation and an independent republic; the sources do not discuss the use of force.

language-defines-nation.rationale: Catalan nationalism rests on language, history and self-government as the marks of a nation, as in Prat de la Riba's La nacionalitat catalana and the defence of Catalan.

communal-electorates.rationale: Mainstream Catalan nationalism presents itself as civic and inclusive, with common citizenship for all residents; religious separate electorates have no place in it.

foreign-partition-plot.rationale: Inferred from a movement whose grievance is against the Spanish state, not partition plots; it is itself accused of seeking to divide Spain, not the reverse.

free-public-college.rationale: Inferred from ERC and CUP social-democratic and left wings favoring low tuition, while the centre-right wing is split.

pollution-taxes.rationale: Inferred from the ERC and CUP left wings and Catalonia's own carbon taxes; the centre-right Junts wing is less committed.

future-generations.rationale: Inferred from the movement's broad centre-left outlook, which generally backs sustainability; not a specifically nationalist matter.

women-distinct-values.rationale: Inferred from ERC and CUP's feminist platforms; the movement spans left and right so adherents are not uniform.

arms-reduction.rationale: Inferred from the left-wing parties' pacifist leanings and the movement's peaceful-referendum stance; not a core demand.

open-diplomacy.rationale: Inferred from the movement's demand for transparent, negotiated referendum terms and its criticism of closed Madrid-state dealings.

capital-controls.rationale: Split: the left wing opposes the free-market model, but an independent Catalonia within the EU would be bound by free capital movement.

state-arms-monopoly.rationale: Not addressed; the movement stresses peaceful, civic politics and wants its own police, the Mossos, as part of a future state, so a state monopoly is accepted.

soldiers-refuse-war.rationale: Catalan nationalism has a strong pacifist and anti-militarist streak, especially in ERC and the CUP, but conservative wings do not endorse refusal.

collective-bargaining.rationale: Inferred from the left wing (ERC, CUP) and the Catalan labour tradition; the centre-right Junts is less committed.

in-work-tax-credits.rationale: Not addressed; the movement spans left and right so inferred as split.

fiscal-rules-binding.rationale: The movement's right wing favours fiscal discipline and the left rejects EU-imposed austerity rules; split.

restructure-world-economy.rationale: Not addressed; inferred as split between the left's anti-globalisation positions and the centre-right's pro-market stance.

smash-state-machine.rationale: The movement wants to build a new Catalan republic through referendum and legal means, not to smash the state apparatus as such, though it seeks to leave the Spanish state.

free-economic-experiment.rationale: Inferred as split across the left and right wings, with no common view on economic pluralism.

nature-as-capital.rationale: Not addressed; the movement spans market-friendly and ecological positions.

sacred-nation.rationale: Catalan nationalism presents itself as civic and inclusive and its language of the nation is cultural and historical, not sacred; adherents differ.

student-debt-relief.rationale: Not addressed; inferred as split, and tuition policy is a regional issue where adherents debate lower fees more than debt relief.

internal-colonialism.rationale: The independence movement's central grievance is fiscal plunder and cultural subordination by the Spanish centre, a claim like internal colonialism.

shared-human-nature.rationale: Not addressed; the movement is a political one with no common philosophy of human nature.

public-service-media.rationale: Catalan nationalists defend the Catalan public broadcaster CCMA as a pillar of language recovery, though they contest its independence from the Catalan government.

religions-one-truth.rationale: Catalan nationalism spans Catholic, secular and left currents and takes no stance on whether religions share one truth; inferred, so neutral.

farm-price-support.rationale: ERC has rural and agrarian roots but the movement spans left and centre-right and the sources do not discuss price supports; adherents split.

keep-nuclear-weapons.rationale: Inferred from ERC's pro-EU, left-leaning line and Catalan nationalists' generally pacifist, anti-militarist stance; Catalonia has no nuclear weapons and the sources do not discuss them.

workers-own-party.rationale: The left wing (ERC, CUP) is sympathetic to labour parties while the centre-right Junts wing favours cross-class national parties; inferred, adherents split.

ban-fgm.rationale: Inferred from ERC's social-democratic platform and pro-human-rights positions; FGM is not discussed in the sources.

women-property-inheritance.rationale: ERC's social-democratic platform supports gender equality and the movement presents itself as inclusive and rights-based.

one-language-many-names.rationale: ERC's platform, through the Catalan Countries idea, holds that Catalan, Valencian and Balearic varieties are one language.

pollution-tort-liability.rationale: Inferred from ERC's social-democratic preference for public regulation over private liability; pollution is not discussed.

customary-chiefs-lawmaking.rationale: Inferred from the movement's republican and parliamentary tradition, which offers no role for customary chiefs; not discussed.

environment-over-liberty.rationale: ERC's platform includes environmental sustainability, but the centre-right wing differs and priority over liberty is not stated; adherents split.

mandatory-sentences.rationale: Inferred from ERC's left-liberal stress on rehabilitation and civil liberties; sentencing is not discussed in the sources.

immigrants-learn-language.rationale: Catalan language policy treats Catalan as the common language of public life and schooling, and nationalism wants newcomers to learn it, though the line stays inclusive and not coercive.
